comparator.name: Wiskunde (Mathematics)
comparator.sourceNotes: The ordinary Mathematics pathway closes 60+60+60 with 82.5 EC compulsory study, one selected 7.5-EC modelling course, 15 EC restricted choice, 30 EC further mathematics choice and 45 EC genuine profiling. The selected set meets the 30-EC major level-3 minimum. Modelling preparation is treated as advisory rather than invented as a hard prerequisite. Mathematics and Applications is not substituted. Formal instruction is Dutch plus English.
